Shadab Khan unleashes a breathtaking 76* off just 21 balls to power UAE Bulls to a thrilling 6-wicket victory!
Chasing 132, Shadab smashed 9 sixes as UAE Bulls raced to the target in just 9.5 overs. Brandon King's unbeaten 60 off 27 went in vain as the Bulls pulled off a spectacular chase.
Watch 2026 | 7th NOV to 20th NOV on Star Sports & JioHotstar.
